calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-30-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Bruce Chan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Lois Jones.
Petitioner: Mian Ying Chen, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Li Wen Chen, and with Cantonese Interpreter Shuna Lei.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
Petitioner/Father Hongjin Chen not present, but consented and signed the Petition for Change of Name of a Minor.
No objections to the proposed change of name of the Minor were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Karen Li Wen Chen.
Decree signed in open court.
